105010.t: Some time later...
Oblia keeps moving her hideout while analyzing the modified code.
Instead of returning to the Outer Loop, Mane is staying near Humanitas for a while to assist Oblia...
She helps with our work occasionally, but causes chaos far more often, so I'm not so sure she's actually helpful...
Thanks to that, Naughty Cats and other back-alley gangs haven't been seen anywhere lately.
Well, we thoroughly wiped the floor with everyone starting from their boss, so they won't be acting up for a while.
However, this kind of notoriety is uncomfortable in its own way...
M.A.D. Hideout
Sigh... Our work has completely dried up again...
Just because we blew up a few things and cleaned up some back-alley gangs, why are WE being treated like one?
Besides, strange rock giants are appearing in New City, weird masquerade balls are cropping up in Vermont...
No matter which world you're in, making a living is damn tough.

Big Boss, Big Boss!
I landed us a job today!!

Ohhh...! You finally pulled through, Freeloader No. 1!
I hereby graduate you from freeloader status as of today!
Who are you calling a freeloader?!

I'm joking, I'm joking.
It's not like it's the first time, why so sensitive?
So? What kind of job is it that has you grinning ear to ear?

Hehe, you bet!
Prepare to have your mind blown!
It's a mere four hours of work a day, with a daily pay of eight hundred thousand Credits! Per person!
Two hundred thousand Credits an hour? That's pretty lucrative!
Where on earth did you manage to hook...

Wait...?!
You... didn't get scammed again, did you?

Hehe, definitely not!
Just hear me out first!

You know how the streets in New City are a total wreck lately?
So Humanitas City Hall tried to mobilize the sanitation crew to clean up!
Except the sanitation crew all went on strike!
Honestly, I'd go on strike too.
So? How does that turn into a job for us?

Anyway!
Because of that, City Hall is recruiting people to do the cleanup instead!
There were barely any applicants though, so the daily rate kept climbing until it reached this!

Of course they have to pay that much!!
It's clearing building debris, not trash!! And in a hazard zone!!
Who knows when that stone monster might pop up again?!
Aww, Big Boss, you worry too much!
We all banded together and beat it last time, so why couldn't we do it again?!
You don't know that for sure!!

...Sigh. Besides, why are sanitation workers being mobilized to clear heavy debris in the first place?
No wonder they went on strike.
Who knows? It's not like City Hall's terrible handling of things is anything new.

Thanks to that, Black Angel and the Fit Angels were thrilled!
Said they got another workout in!
They're the type to ask to be paid in protein powder instead, so I'm not even surprised.
Besides, those girls have ties to the New City construction companies...
Wait a second, when did you even hang out with them enough to get that close?
Huh? I didn't really do anything special.
Ever since that last job, we just say hi whenever we bump into each other on the street.

As expected of a human Golden Retriever.
Your sociability is off the charts.
Who are you calling a Golden Retriever?!

Whatever you say, Goldie.
Anyway...
Sounds like you got the request from Black Angel, not the city.

As expected of the Big Boss!
You're quick on the uptake!
They said they'd handle all the heavy stuff and asked if we could take care of the glass and annoying debris!

Sigh...
So we're a subcontract of a subcontract.
Who cares? As long as it pays well!

They said they're happy as long as they get to work out!
So we get to pocket the money!
Look at you growing up, Freya!
Now that's the Fixer spirit!
...By the way, Freya. There's something I've been wondering about.
Huh? What is it, what is it?

Were there always this many monsters around the city?
Or did things just recently start going out of hand?
Monsters? Beats me! I'm not really one to watch the news!
We made M.A.D. to have fun in the first place, so why bother worrying about that?
Sigh, it's my fault for expecting anything from you in the first place.

Ah, I'd better ask Lumina instead.
She's sharp when it comes to rumors.
Never around when I actually need her, that eropink head.
If you mean Lumina, she went out early this morning.

Really?
She snuck out before I knew it.
I did hear her muttering that today felt like a day to go on an outing.
I heard no further details beyond that.
Hmm... Well, it's not like I have anything urgent today.
If something comes up, I can just MochiTalk her—
What, did you order a package or something?

No.
I have never purchased anything for delivery before.
Usually, a package would just be useless junk ordered by  or Freya.

Useless?!
Everything I buy has a purpose!
...But I really didn't order anything this time, you know?

Big Boss, be honest.
Did you blow through our last reward money again...
In that case, the probability that our visitor is a loan shark has increased by 20%.
Shall I request Lafine to analyze a quick escape route from the building?

No need!!
I never borrowed any money or lost it in the first place?!!
...Though, I did dabble a tiny bit in stocks and crypto with Suji's help—
Aha! So this time you didn't lose it all at the casino, you lost it all on 'investments'?!

Hand over the Quartz.
I will make sure you can never press the buy or sell buttons again.

Like you two could actually—
No, more importantly, it's not a loan shark!!
If you don't believe me, why don't you go open the door and see?!

Fine, I'm going, I'm going!
Let's see who's out there—
What? What is it?!

H-Heeek... The door!!
The door split in two!!
O-Our deposit just split in two again...!!
I knocked three times and got no response, so I opened the door by force...

So it is you.
The ones said to run a Fixer Office here.
I came after hearing that an unauthorized deserter from our side was working here...
An unauthorized deserter?
A nun with pink hair who cracks strange jokes every chance she gets.

Hmm...
She does not appear to be here.
...So you can see even like that.

Hmm?
Did you say something?
No, nothing.
...I can see that is a blatantly obvious lie.

You're blindfolded.
What can you even see?
And besides that...
How are you standing there so confident after slicing someone else's door in half like tofu??
Do you really think that's how things should go?? Huh???

Ahem... For that, I apologize.
I assumed the deserter was locking the door and refusing to open it—

So what?
Are you a cop or something?
I don't care what you Harmonix Faith folks squabble over back in Vermont, but that doesn't fly here.

Turning our place into this mess and then asking for cooperation? Hah...
The prestige of the Harmonix Faith is in the gutter!!

Theta, did you hear that?
He said 'our' place, 'our' place.

I heard, Freya.
Even though we are the ones who signed the lease.

Quiet over there, you idiots. I can hear you.
And I pay most of the rent with my own earnings, you know?!

Anyway, what are you going to do about this? Property damage, trespassing...
Ah, should I tack on attempted kidnapping while I'm at it?

Should I call the cops? Want to get scolded over donuts?
Or are you going to compensate us quietly?
Ah, of course, if you don't have money, there's always paying with your body—
...I shall compensate you.

In exchange...
I would like you to hear me out for a moment.
...Huh?

105020.t: M.A.D. Hideout
...Paying in cash, huh? A bit disappointing, but...
Pardon? ???

It's nothing.
Anyway...
Just so you know, I'm not handing our Lumina over to just anyone.

Sure, she's a pervert who spits out dirty jokes every chance she gets, and an idiot with nothing but lewd thoughts in her head...
But she's our team's reliable healer.
...Wait, Big Boss, saying you won't hand her over to 'just anyone' means you'd still hand her over to 'someone', right?

Always logical about the most useless things...
Keep that up and I might hand you over first, got it?
Though seeing you in a nun cosplay might actually be quite a sight...
...First, allow me to introduce myself. ???

I am the Mother Superior of Celestial—
Bianca.
Celestial... that's another faction of the Harmonix Faith opposing Feelharmony, right...?

By the way, Mother Superior?
Is that different from an Abbess?

Anyway...
Someone of such high rank came all the way here in person?
Under the mercy of Harmonix, how could anyone be of high or low birth?
I am only in this position because the former Mother Superior favored me. I do not consider myself special at all.
Yeah, yeah, long story short, you're the top nun of that faction, right?

Does Celestial's attire get bolder the higher your rank is...?
It really is different from Feelharmony.
...'For we were called not unto bondage, but unto freedom; thus our bodies are a masterpiece created by Harmonix, and an instrument for praise.'
In other words, this habit was crafted to accentuate the finest masterpiece shaped by Harmonix—our physical bodies.
What is that doctrine? It sounds tailored specifically for exhibitionists to rationalize themselves.
I can think of someone who'd absolutely love that, though...
...It is nothing of the sort.
These are holy words strictly written in the scripture—

Anyway, this is news to me.
I've never even met a follower of Celestial in the first place.

I've seen plenty of Feelharmony nuns...
Even though you worship the same Harmonix, you feel completely different.
Celestial has relatively fewer members compared to Feelharmony.
However, you are mistaken in saying that you have never met a member of Celestial.

Though she has left without permission, Sister Lumina is still a member of our convent—
and a nun who held the vital role of [Evangelist].
Evangelist? Is that like those people on the streets of Humanitas handing out cookies and saying 'Believe in the Harmonix Faith~'?

...Similar, yet different.
Though similar in that she engaged in street evangelism.
However, Celestial's methods of evangelism are not so bland; they are far more passionate.
For instance, gathering crowds by performing sexy dances while wearing liturgical vestments—
Now I'm suddenly getting a lot more interested.
Freya, Freya.

The look in 's eyes is devious.
He is clearly having indecent thoughts again.
Huh? Really? I feel like he always looks like that, though.

By the way, now that I think about it...
I knew Lumina used priest-like powers, but I had no idea she was an actual nun!
Her vibe kind of felt religious, but she never acted like a clergy member at all, right?

Indeed.
Come to think of it, I have never properly seen her pray.
She has never mentioned the goddess Harmonix either.
What? What is it now?
Was there an earthquake or something?

Sigh... No.
I have simply heard many shocking things today.
I wonder what our dumb dirty-joke master was like in the past to warrant a reaction like that.
...That is—
Halt right there, Bianca!

...Ines?!
Why are you here—
This person is a prospective believer that Feelharmony has had our eyes on for a long time!
How dare you try to drag him off to a den of demons like Celestial...!
A den of demons? Since when did Feelharmony become a place that routinely engages in such vulgar, unfounded slander?
Ah, it must have been ever since a succubus who cannot even control her own drive assumed the vital post of Abbess.

Fufu, as if.
I am perfectly capable of maintaining my composure even without relying on tools, you know?
And if leading lay believers astray to teach them pleasure isn't the work of demons, then what is?
I fail to see what is wrong with proudly and freely showing off Harmonix's greatest masterpiece.
What are you trying to teach through oppression rather than moderation?
Your habit of kidnapping passing lay believers, soaking them in pleasure, and leaving them unable to escape is what's wrong!
Both your attire and your behavior are utterly shameless!
Hey, nuns.
Ah, seriously.

Hey!!
You lustful nun and exposure freak nun!!
W-W-W-Who are you calling a lustful nun?!
W-W-W-Who are you calling an exposure freak nun?!
Enough!
If you're going to keep fighting, take it outside!
Why are you barging into someone else's house and beating each other up??
Kyaa?!
Hmm...

And besides, the Lumina you're looking for isn't here anyway.
If you have something to say, come back to find her later—or don't.
Of course, that doesn't mean you have permission to take her, got it?

Understood.
I shall visit again another time.
However, I will take Sister Lumina with me.

...Phew. I can breathe a sigh of relief.
I thought a brawl was about to break out.
Ever since I was a lay believer, I have never physically beaten Bianca in a fight...
Yep, avoiding a fight is always best.
And you get out too.
Huh?
No, why did you even come here in the first place?

You're trying to trick me into joining the Harmonix Faith again, aren't you?
I'm not falling for it this time.
Oh my, what a shame... I mean, no!

I didn't come here for missionary activity today.
I just had some business in Humanitas...

While I was at it, I heard Celestial was running rampant in Humanitas.
So I just did a little bit of tailing... just a tiny bit...
A nun tailing people... The world really is turning strange.
In the first place, what's the deal between your group and theirs anyway?
Th-That...

105030.t: Humanitas Alley
So... Celestial is also a faction worshipping Harmonix, but their methods are just a bit unusual, right?

Boasting their bodies, indulging in pleasure through provocative songs and dances...
Hmm...

...Sounds great to me?
Better than being stiff and boring.

What about that is great?!
E-Expressing your Drive freely like that can't possibly be true faith—
Seems to me it's just a different standard of piety.
I don't really want to hear that from a nun overflowing with Drive herself.
T-There might have been times like that, but!
I came to Humanitas today on serious business, so I won't have time for that!
Sure, let's wait and see about that.
By the way, it's pretty fascinating how two factions under the same religion can be so wildly different.
Sigh... I feel the exact same way...
The [Sanctus See] recognized the legitimacy of both sides... and forbade conflicts between us...

Mm, we are still so completely different...
Like oil and water.
Sanctus... See?
What's that, some constellation that hands down divine revelations?
Ahaha... It is true that it's connected to divine revelations, but it's not a constellation.
It might be easier to understand if I call it... the headquarters of the Harmonix Faith.

Ah, so like the Vatican.
I don't know who the Pope is, but they must be pretty open-minded.
Pope? What is that?
Uh... like the emperor of the church, I guess.

Never mind.
Just something from where I used to live.
Umm, I don't know where you came from, but across all the surrounding cities, the Harmonix Faith is the only religion...?

Though there are shrines in the Four Gentlemen to honor ancient heroes...
That's a bit different from worshipping a deity.

Hmm...
Is that so...?

Anyway!
The Sanctus See is led by Saintess Vesperi.

A saint, huh...
I wonder what kind of person she is.
She is the one tasked with receiving divine revelations from Harmonix and proclaiming them to everyone.
She is more beautiful and holy than anyone else.
If she's that holy, she must be very open-minded.
Fufu, she possesses extraordinary tolerance.

...B-By the way, Fixer?
May I ask you something...?
Huh? What is it?

It might be a bit late to ask, but you definitely told me to leave earlier...
So why... are you following me...?

Ah...!
Could it be... you're finally joining Feelharmony...!

As if.
Stop being so obsessed.
Sigh... What a shame...

It seemed like that woman earlier was targeting Lumina...
Even if Lumina's an idiot, she's our idiot, so I've got to look out for her.

And since you were heading toward downtown too, we just happen to be going the same way.
Get it?

Theta, did you hear that?
He called her 'our' idiot, 'our' idiot.

I heard, Freya.
However, Boss treats all of us like idiots anyway.

You two over there, you've been whispering loudly for a while now.
What kind of routine is that?
Well, I just felt like Big Boss hit 100% belonging with MAke Drama before we knew it~

I hardly felt that from you before, you know?
Heheh.
You looked as if you might leave anytime, anywhere.
It felt like you only stayed because you found a place where you didn't have to pay rent separately.
Like I said earlier, I earn most of the rent money, you know?!
Besides, the number of requests I solve overwhelmingly outnumbers the ones you two solve?!
Those are just minor requests like finding lost cats anyway!
And Big Boss spends just as much money anyway.
If you used money wisely, we would have no reason to nag.
I assume I do not need to bring up the time you went to the casino?

Ah, seriously...
Fine, I get it.
You two are total airheads usually, but you remember things to nag me about with scary accuracy...

I'm not an airhead!
Despite how I look, I have plenty of common sense and know a lot of things—
What's 12 times 12?
...Don't throw math at me all of a sudden!!

It is 144.
That is far too easy a question.
What's 8568 times 663?

5,680,584.
Far too easy. Heh.

Be honest.
You used a calculator app in your head, didn't you?
Sigh, typical.
Ahaha, you all get along so well...
Get along? We're busy bickering every single day.

Anyway, Ines, what brings you to Humanitas? You said earlier you had business here.
Is it okay for you to be slacking off like this?
Slacking off?! Keeping Celestial in check is absolutely necessary!

Though... that's true.
I do need to head back soon.
...What kind of business— Mmph!

Ehehe...
Chise, what did I tell ya~

I told ya I felt an intense Will of the Sword coming from this direction...
*Hic*.

Indeed, Hiyori-senpai.
The direction you indicated was accurate.
However... hmm. As this humble one senses it, the Will of the Sword you mentioned does not seem to emanate from the esteemed individuals before us.
But what's this suddenly squished between my breasts~
It's warm and fits just right~
...Mmph... Who is that...!
It has been a while, Fixer.
Thanks to the wisdom you lent me before, Fixer, I was able to dedicate myself to the sword with a mind at ease once again.

Well, that's great to hear.
By the way...
...Why are you loitering in the alley in front of my house?

I was traveling on a warrior's pilgrimage.
My steps simply happened to lead me to Humanitas along the way.

Since your office was nearby anyway, Fixer, I intended to stop by to greet you...
However, I sensed an intense aura of a sword.
An aura of a sword?
Ah...
Heheh... Judging by that reaction, looks like you know who we came looking for!

Allow me to introduce her.
This is...
First Sword of the Four Seasons. Senior Hiyori.

Hehehe... Nice to meet ya...
Hic.
What's with this drunkard?

105031.t: Cafe Street
...Hmm. As expected, the aroma of tea in Humanitas is quite different from that of Vermont.
It tastes fine, but... I do not feel any true heart poured into it.
Mother Superior Bianca.
...Elder Exenos.
...So, how did your business go?
There were no notable results. I have not even seen Lumina's face yet.
Fufufu... She always had remarkably good instincts.
Along with immense potential worthy of being nominated as a candidate for the next Saintess...
Elder Exenos.
...Yes, Mother Superior Bianca?
Why did you come all the way to Humanitas in person?
I clearly stated that I would handle this matter myself.
Because it is not a matter that requires the Mother Superior to step in personally.
Lumina merely left without permission and is not a target for execution, so there is no reason for you to step in directly, Bianca.
Besides, wouldn't it look rather odd for the Mother Superior to suddenly go looking for a girl who departed so long ago?
In that sense, having an Elder bring Lumina back is also a problem.
Exenos, if you have another motive, please speak up.
Another motive? What an absurd suggestion.
We are merely bringing the word of Harmonix to fruition.
As one of the founders of Celestial and a former Mother Superior, Exenos...
You are a respected senior in many ways, and I do my best to treat you with appropriate deference.
Fufu... Though back then, the title was still "Abbess," just like Feelharmony's...
Ah, I am so glad we changed the title...
The reason for your stepping down, Senior Exenos, was your extreme conflict with Feelharmony, which prompted the intervention of the Sanctus See.
I have no intention of defending Feelharmony, but Vermont back then was practically a battlefield for nuns, was it not?
Ah, I only regret that I was unable to reveal the truth to those ignorant fools to the very end.
The Saintess can be so heartless... Fufufu...
...You were radical back then as well, but you have become even more extreme since becoming the leader of the Ascetics.
Please, do not create a situation where I must use Blind Judgment.
Do you understand what I mean?
Yes, Mother Superior Bianca.
However, I consider it inappropriate to leave you alone in this sin-filled city, Mother Superior.
So... I shall assign an escort to you.
What the...
Did you call for me, Exenos?
Assist Mother Superior Bianca, Spica. She may be in need of "help."
Sigh... In any case, please keep my words in mind.
Let's go, Spica.
Fufufu...
All according to the will of Harmonix.

105040.t: Humanitas Alley

A drunkard...?
Where would someone like that be...Hic.

The person here is... one who lives by the sword and dies by the sword...
Just a single swordswoman, that's all! Ahahaha!
No matter how I look at it, you're just a random daytime drunkard living and dying by alcohol...
So, what did you say your purpose here was?
When warriors of the Four Gentlemen have no specific duties, they embark on pilgrimages to broaden their horizons.

I also journeyed to Humanitas to test my skills against the strong from all over the world...
However, upon arrival, ahem...

The first formidable opponent I encountered here...
happened to be my esteemed senior, which caught me quite off guard.
Hehehe, you still have a long way to go, Chise!
If you want to be my match, go build up your alcohol tolerance first!
Wait... Don't tell me your warrior training is drinking training instead of sword training??
Shouldn't you change your title from First Sword of the Four Seasons to First Drinker of the Four Seasons?

...A-Ah, well, while it might look that way to an outsider...
Senior Hiyori isn't actually on a pilgrimage in the first place.
Even though The Four Seasons bestowed a title upon her, she's closer to a wandering ronin who belongs nowhere.

Hic...
Speaking of which, Chise, couldn't you lend me a few Credits?
Looks like my travel money is running out!

Ah, of course, Senior.
Here...
As you can see, she's always like this, but calling her someone at the pinnacle of swordsmanship is no exaggeration.
If there is a flaw, it is merely that because she is always drinking, she doesn't look the part at all...

Chise!
You know I couldn't fix that even if I tried!

Are you trying to rob me of my life's greatest pleasure?
Hic...
I only mean that I wish I had more opportunities to see your true sword, Senior Hiyori, rather than your drunken style.

You know full well what happens to me without alcohol...
Hic...
Anyway, when the time comes, when the time comes...
Is she that strong?

Hic...
I win at both swords and booze!
Swords I haven't fought, booze I haven't tasted—I'm confident I can make them all mine after experiencing them once! Hehehe...
Honestly, I'm a bit jealous about the alcohol part.
Though I think I know one sword you've never seen before.

Hmm...?
Oh, is that so?

I'd love to test myself against it sometime, anywhere...
Hehehe...
Late at night, in a place with just the two of us.
Oh, so could the sword aura I sensed earlier be yours...?

But are you sure about that?
Even when I can't see, I can slash through someone else's sword like paper!
...Ugh.

Hic...
Ahahaha, it was obvious that what you said was just a joke!
Your hands... No matter how I look at them, they're not the hands of someone who's ever properly held a sword.

Still... hic...
I am a bit curious about what this sword I've never seen before could be...
Like I said, it really is a sword you've never seen before.
Anyway... when the time comes, when the time comes...

Alright, alright!
Ahahaha...

Ehh...?
Wait, isn't that what I said to Chise earlier...? Hic...

Don't worry about it.
It's not important.

By the way, I know someone who'd make a great drinking buddy for you...
Her name is Mane. I'll introduce you later.
Oh... Ohhh...!!
I don't know how much she can drink for you to say that, buuut...

She sounds like someone I'd love to meet soon...
Hic...
...Well, the problem is she mostly drinks beer and acts like a total robber.
Anyway, the sword wielder you were looking for isn't here.
Someone did come by our hideout earlier, but she left for somewhere a while ago.
Is that so... That is unfortunate.
In this city, while there are many masters in other fields, masters of the sword are rare.

If you want, Theta can be your opponent.
She technically uses a sword too, you know?
Heh... My Gigant Sword craves bread.
Give me bread, and I shall face you.
Unless one puts their heart into the blade and clashes with full resolve, I believe it has no meaning as a spar...
I have a powerful resolve to eat bread.
Fufu, I believe that resolve carries a slightly different meaning...
Hehehe, I'll pass for now too!

Unlike Chise, I just came here to hang out!
And if it's not someone my sword responds to, I just can't get motivated!

Mmm... What a shame.
Bread...
Instead, if you help us find a good opponent, I would be more than happy to buy you a few pieces of bread.
Ah, if you prefer, rice cakes instead of bread...
Activating sensors immediately.
That eye-patched woman from earlier—if she comes within 100 meters, I will be able to locate her instantly.

...How?
I thought you were only capable of bread sensing?

Trade secret.
Shh.
Well, knowing where she is won't hurt.
Though that's assuming those two keep hanging around with us.
Last time Freya abandoned everyone, and now it's you?!
I didn't abandon anyone!!!

I am not abandoning you.
I am setting off to acquire daily provisions.

Both of you, be quiet.
Maybe I should just hand you both over to the bakery owner.
Fufu... If I may walk alongside you, Fixer, it would be my honor.
Senior Hiyori, will you be staying with us as well?

Ehehehe...
As long as I can drink booze, anything is fine by me!
Harmonix, please forgive the sins of those causing sword brawls and drunk revelry in the streets...

Ah, right.
I completely forgot.
You're still here, Ines?
Th-That's a bit harsh, don't you think...
Just kidding, just kidding.
Anyway, you're staying with us until we find Lumina.
Didn't your Saintess forbid you from fighting Celestial directly?
Then I guess we can just put you out front as a meat shield.

A meat shield...?
At least call me a guardian...
And I have my own duties to attend to...

Well, we'll help you with your stuff while we're at it, so let's call it even if you help us too.
Okay?

Sigh... I suppose I have no choice.
Who could possibly break your stubbornness, Fixer?
Shall we head to the hospital first, then?

105050.t: Saverim
Oh, seriously!
If you keep moving like that, it's hard to cast a healing blessing on you!
Achoo-nyan!!
Kyaaah!!! Sp-Spit in my eyes...!!!
Phehe... The world is spinning, nyan...
Phew... I really don't like using the martial arts I trained so hard for like this, but...
Take that!
BAM!!!
Gyahh!!!
Hunyanyan...
Phew, finally quieted down...
Thanks, Airen! Now I can finally do my job!
Zzz... Zzz...
If you're fully healed, stop pretending to be asleep and get out already!
Haah!
Kieeehk!!!
Sigh, what an utter mess.
Vermont and Humanitas both... What in the world is going on with all this chaos...
Hing, thanks to this, I haven't even been able to film vlogs lately, so my Mochi Creator rank dropped...
My original plan today to film the [Overflowing Hearts, Surging Nectar] challenge is totally down the drain... My content is ruined, waaaah...
I'm back, everyone.
Ah, Abbess Ines! Did you defeat Celestial's demons?
I knew it, I should have come with you—
Fufu, because you were here, Airen, the patients were able to rest peacefully.
Did anything happen while I was away?
Nothing major, but... at some point, the patients just couldn't sit still.
To the point where we couldn't handle them unless we resorted to physical force...
Their condition worsened this much in the short time I was gone...?
It seems withdrawal symptoms hit them all at once, as if they caught the scent at the same time...
They started breaking down one or two at a time, and now, as you can see...
